end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making teen numbers with one bundle of ten and loose ones, and explained that the 1 means one ten. They mixed up 14 and 41 when writing the digits; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, use sticks or small objects to make 10 plus some more, then say and write the number, checking that the 1 comes first.
